body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: cut**

The type k_plane_t (k_vnni_tensor) says it is the packed K plane, and that type has no raw access, so 'written through the typed operations' restates the type's contract. The paired comment on line 72 (the same K, one row per token) carries the relation between the two members.

Proposed: cut the comment.
